title: Asleep
description: Creature enters a dormant state. Awakens when HP is lost or after the duration expires.
smart_description: Awakens upon losing HP or after [blue]{Amount}[/blue] turns.
notes: This power is specific to Lagavulin Matriarch. It decrements by 1 each turn and awakens immediately if the owner takes unblocked damage. When the counter reaches 0 at turn end, the creature performs its WakeUpMove. Upon awakening, any associated PlatingPower is removed first.
